RWA.note: Document names no farming service using satellite data.

facts.fact: Meteo Rwanda's deck says it runs PUMA-2025 reception stations giving real-time processing and visualisation of MTG satellite data alongside its radar network.

Meteo Rwanda says its severe thunderstorm warning lead time rose from 15 minutes in 2021 to a projected 60 minutes in 2026, with a significant jump since MTG start, and describes impact-based flash flood and storm warnings.
Meteo Rwanda's deck states its operations are ISO 9001:2015 certified.
